exposure: combination of 5 metrics of cardiovascular health
finding: More favorable cardiovascular health at 24 to 32 weeks' gestation was associated with lower risks for preeclampsia, unplanned primary cesarean delivery, high newborn birthweight, high sum of skinfolds, and low insulin sensitivity.
mod_finding: More favorable cardiovascular health at 24 to 32 weeks' gestation was associated with lower risks of unplanned primary cesarean delivery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 39.8 weeks
